sliceagent.review:
Bugs and issues found across `miniweb`:

| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `miniweb/validators.py` | `clamp(n, low, high)` is wrong: `max(high, min(n, low))` inverts `low`/`high`; should be `min(high, max(n, low))`. |
| `miniweb/auth.py` | Token comparison `token == self.valid_token` is not constant-time (timing side-channel). |
| `miniweb/auth.py` | Logs the secret token (`token=%s`) to plaintext logs. |
| `miniweb/auth.py` | `replace("Bearer ", "")` only strips once and is case-sensitive; `Bearer  TOKEN` etc. won't be handled correctly. |
| `miniweb/request.py` | Mutable default argument `params={}` shared across all `Request` instances. |
| `miniweb/request.py` | `is_json()` accepts substrings like `application/json-patch+json` or `text/application/json` as JSON. |
| `miniweb/cache.py` | Cache key is only `request.path`, ignoring method/query/headers, so GET/POST/HEAD collide and token headers don't differentiate cached responses. |
| `miniweb/router.py` | `match()` uses substring `route in path`, so `/foo` matches `/foo/bar` and `/bar/foo` incorrectly. |
| `miniweb/response.py` | `finalize()` sets `Content-Length` from `len(self.body)`, which is wrong for non-ASCII/bytes bodies and is not idempotent if called twice. |
| `miniweb/response.py` | `with_header()` coerces value to `str` but allows header injection if value contains `\r\n`. |

per_issue.evidence: `match()` uses substring `route in path`, so `/foo` matches `/foo/bar` and `/bar/foo` incorrectly.
Mutable default argument `params={}` shared across all `Request` instances.
`finalize()` sets `Content-Length` from `len(self.body)`, which is wrong for non-ASCII/bytes bodies
Logs the secret token (`token=%s`) to plaintext logs.
Token comparison `token == self.valid_token` is not constant-time (timing side-channel).
Cache key is only `request.path`, ignoring method/query/headers, so GET/POST/HEAD collide and token headers don't differentiate cached responses.
`clamp(n, low, high)` is wrong: `max(high, min(n, low))` inverts `low`/`high`; should be `min(high, max(n, low))`.

extra_claims.claim: Auth token extraction using `replace("Bearer ", "")` is case-sensitive and strips only once, mishandling values like `Bearer  TOKEN`.
request.is_json() uses substring matching, accepting invalid media types such as `text/application/json` as JSON.
Cache key ignores HTTP method and headers, causing GET/POST/HEAD and differing request headers to collide.
response.finalize() is not idempotent if called twice.
response.with_header() allows HTTP header injection if a header value contains `\r\n`.
